comparison.objective: Saw a marked 45-degree mitre while keeping moulding against a mitre-box fence.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand stabilizes a workpiece while the other reciprocates and guides a saw through an angled slot.
comparison.success_condition: The cut reaches specified depth or completion, with full credit also requiring tool return and released workpiece placement.
comparison.reason: It shares generic stabilization against tool reaction, but tests reciprocating cutting rather than coupled rotary adjustment and jam-nut locking.
